mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, increasing valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payrolls indicate severe labor market stress, triggering a market sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, SPX 60-day returns are positive or flat in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy reduces liquidity and raises discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 950,000 units indicate a housing market collapse, reducing consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 950, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a broad-based consumer demand collapse, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls and RSAFS falls, SPX 60-day returns are positive or flat in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary labor markets (UNRATE > 6.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
